hierarchy.notes: Route-local stack composition with a pure tested runbook and fail-closed readiness model, explicit local-first trust boundary, and actionable coverage repair.

classification.notes: The route reads compile-time public provider metadata and builds reviewable command text locally. It makes no provider, database, auth, usage, or upload request.

ssa_v2.notes: Server composition, pure candidate/runbook/readiness logic, client interaction, and responsive styling are isolated; every owned source file stays below 300 lines.

ssi.notes: The server route maps the registry once, the pure module owns collection-path precedence, runbook generation, and readiness diagnosis, and one client component owns selection and clipboard state.

sstf.notes: Thirteen focused source tests cover collection-path truth, multi-field search, registry-backed presets, every readiness state, fail-closed planned coverage, dry-run defaults, deduplicated detection, and forbidden client behavior.

spe.notes: Search renders at most 12 source candidates while selected tools remain visible independently. Mobile puts diagnosis and runbook before the catalog; 4K expands to a 3000px rail and measured 2952px workbench with legible fixed-size type and zero horizontal overflow.

srs.notes: Collection-path meanings become a decisive readiness state, trackable/automatic/verified/visibility metrics, explicit consequence, and one next action. Empty, blocked, partial, manual-review, and ready states all fail visibly without inflating usage.

ssra.notes: The committed source release passes its full gate and Next build. Canonical deploy 6a5736b626defad5dde0daa0 contains this source release plus the concurrent profile polish, and browser proofs cover all five diagnosis states, removal recovery, mobile, desktop, and 3840x2160. The current integrated worktree separately has one pending profile-route contract mismatch outside this module.

sas.notes: The route has an explicit owned-path manifest, SMA lease evidence, module-local files, and no shared-contract edit.

sva.notes: The client performs no fetch, provider call, secret access, persistent storage, usage mutation, command execution, or upload. Clipboard access requires an explicit user action.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: Next and React are inherited from the web package; this slice adds no runtime dependency.

sai.notes: The source and route-contract leases, intent, owned paths, gates, deployment, and browser proof are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The route is split into server composition, a pure tested data model, one client workbench, two focused stylesheets, and tests with no new dependency.

Canonical locked deploy 6a5736b626defad5dde0daa0 serves the source readiness console and concurrent profile UI together; stable checks prove PARTIAL COVERAGE, the 3-of-4 headline, removal action, and responsive source rendering.

verification.summary: Turned raw source path labels into a fail-closed readiness diagnosis with coverage metrics, concrete repair actions, and responsive operator hierarchy.

Playwright proved presets, explicit domain filters, source selection, path-count changes, exact clipboard output, zero browser errors, zero failed requests, zero horizontal overflow, selected-first mobile flow, and the 2640px two-column 4K workbench at 390x844, 1440x1000, and 3840x2160.
